generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The Employer reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason or what so ever
The earnest money deposit will be forfeited if the documents submitted by the tenderer found to be misleading/forged or fake
Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2024-25
Turnover certificate from CA with valid UDIN No. to be furnished along with necessary documents
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt., orders as may be modified from time to time
GST shall be paid to the tendered amount separately
Increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period at contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by authority while granting is extension of time.
All terms and conditions are as per the tender notification and KW-3
Contracter should fallow the prevailing guidelines of labour department

technicalCriterionList.description: Achieved in at least two financial years a minimum annual financial turnover should be Rs.82.30 Lakhs. Turnover certificate from CA with valid UDIN No. to be furnished along with necessary documents and Annual Profit and Loss Statement last five years i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: Satisfactory completed as prime contractor at least one similar Nature of Comprehensive Improvement of Circle/Development of Junction work of value not less than Rs.41.15 Lakh (Along with Work Indent Number) in last 5 previous years

Executed in any one year (for a continuous period of 12 months) the following minimum quantities of work in last 5 previous financial years 1)All type of concrete work -Cum-93.40 2)Plastering-work-Sqm-328.80 3) Wall Cladding Tiles/Flooring Tiles Works-Sqm-333.38 4)TMT Steel-Tonne-12.16in
PWD CONTRACTER REGISTRATION AS PER BID DOCUMENT

Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as per bid document

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self assesed bid capacity with valid supporting documents mentioned in bid document
